ctx.x: And we had another guy was in the band and we was up in Canada and this Frenchy is -- instead of going into a good hotel, he went in a ricky-tick hotel that was condemned and luckily I didn't stay there and two or three others didn't

stay but Earl Hines and guy -- bass player from Texas, Jonesy, we used to call him-- Jones, and they stayed in this hotel someone -- one morning we get up and saw the smoke coming like from the place so he said, oh, there must be a fire at the place where we're working, sure enough it was. So we put on some clothes and we went on down there --Earl Hines in standing out in the street, a cigar in his mouth and a hat on his head, half naked. Poor Jonesy, he couldn't get out -- they had -- the exit doors were nailed,…
That, Joe's lawyer and the other lawyer made a settlement, I guess, and this poor guy he didn't get a dime out of the whole bit.
